content:
The tallest building in the world is the Burj Khalifa in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

Some key facts about the Burj Khalifa:

- Height: 828 meters (2,717 feet)
- It has 163 floors.
- It was completed in 2010.
- It surpassed the previous record holder, the Taipei 101 building in Taiwan, which stood at 509.2 meters (1,671 feet).
- The Burj Khalifa is not only the tallest building, but also the tallest freestanding structure in the world.
- It is a mixed-use building, containing residential, hotel, and commercial spaces.
- The building was designed by the architectural firm Skidmore, Owings and Merrill.

So in summary, the Burj Khalifa in Dubai is currently recognized as the tallest building in the world, towering over all other skyscrapers globally.
